weapon.d:
Accelerates Special trigger (cooldown count-1).
If unit is not adjacent to an ally, inflicts penalty on foe's Atk/Spd/Def/Res during combat = 5 + any current penalty on each of those stats. (Example: if foe has -7 penalty to Atk, inflicts Atk-12, for a net penalty of Atk-19 during combat.) Calculates each stat penalty independently.

special.d: Treats foe's Def/Res as if reduced by 30% during combat.
Treats foe's Def/Res as if reduced by 50% during combat.

a.d: If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+2 during combat.
If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat.
If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+6 during combat.
If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+7 during combat.

b.d: At start of turn, inflicts Res-3 on foe on the enemy team with the highest Res through its next action.
At start of turn, inflicts Def/Res-3 on foe on the enemy team with the highest Def+Res total through its next action.
At start of turn, inflicts Def/Res-5 on foe on the enemy team with the highest Def+Res total through its next action.

c.d: Inflicts Atk/Res-2 on foes within 2 spaces during combat.
Inflicts Atk/Res-3 on foes within 2 spaces during combat.
Inflicts Atk/Res-4 on foes within 2 spaces during combat.
